Iris Data

```{r}
library(rpart)
library(rattle)
species_tree=rpart(Species~.,
                   data=iris,
                   method="class")
fancyRpartPlot(species_tree)
```

No need to prune:

```{r}
plotcp(species_tree)
```

```{r}
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/mushroom.csv"
mushroom=read.csv(df_url)
mush_tree=rpart(class~.,data=mushroom,method="class")
fancyRpartPlot(mush_tree)
```

```{r}
yhat=predict(mush_tree,mushroom,type="class")
table(yhat,mushroom$class)
```
